title: Calibrated Typed Decisions for Entity, Relation, and Event Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2610.17113v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Information extraction models often perform well on the datasets they are trained on, but transferring to new domains and annotation guidelines remains challenging. Supporting user-specified types alone does not resolve this problem. We present CalOn, a unified 0.6B-parameter encoder for entity, relation, and event extraction across datasets and schemas. The model jointly encodes text and type definitions, then directly identifies entity spans, relations between spans, and event triggers and arguments. Its extraction decisions consider the requested types together, using their combined evidence to identify relevant candidates before assigning a type. This gives all three tasks a common probabilistic formulation while keeping every extracted mention anchored to the input text. We train on diverse sources, and supplement supervised learning with a reward that encourages correct extractions and penalises incorrect ones. Across 40 benchmar

translated_title: 面向实体、关系与事件抽取的校准类型化决策
translated_abstract: 信息抽取模型在训练所用数据集上往往表现良好，但迁移到新领域和新的标注规范仍然具有挑战性，仅支持用户指定类型并不能解决这一问题。我们提出了CalOn，一个统一的0.6B参数编码器，用于跨数据集和跨模式的实体、关系与事件抽取。该模型联合编码文本与类型定义，然后直接识别实体跨度、跨度之间的关系以及事件触发词和论元。其抽取决策会综合考量所请求的全部类型，利用它们的组合证据在分配类型之前识别相关候选。这为三项任务提供了统一的概率化表述，同时确保每个抽取到的提及都锚定在输入文本之上。我们在多样化的数据源上进行训练，并以奖励机制补充监督学习，该机制鼓励正确的抽取并惩罚错误的抽取。在40个基准（原文此处截断）……
tldr: 提出CalOn——一个0.6B参数的统一编码器，通过联合编码文本与类型定义、以综合证据进行校准类型化决策的方式，实现跨数据集和标注模式的实体、关系与事件抽取。
en_tdlr: CalOn is a unified 0.6B-parameter encoder that jointly encodes text and type definitions, making calibrated typed decisions with combined type evidence to achieve entity, relation, and event extraction across datasets and schemas.
